VBO:0200531.summary: Keen on scent and persistent in pursuit, Foxhounds carry a strong working instinct developed through pack hunting. A good nose, stamina, voice and responsiveness remain central to their work. The broad family includes English, American, Penn-Marydel and Crossbred lines, with individual packs bred for the quarry, terrain and pace of their hunts.
VBO:0200531.shortDescription: Foxhounds are persistent pack hunters, with English, American, Penn-Marydel and Crossbred lines bred for different hunts.
